name: East Pass Cliff & Orom's Station
act: Act II: The Watch on the Overhang & The Grey Wind's Bargain
description: A sheer slate-grey granite cliff face halfway through the Eastern Pass. Orom of the Grey Wind steps out from solid rock like fog, offering to forge one spoken wish into a literal stone slab in exchange for the True Name of the Seventh Ruin.

cast.name: Orom of the Grey Wind
cast.description: Nine-foot entity of matte slate-grey skin who steps through solid cliffs. Ignores game-theoretic bribes; translates spoken intent with coarse literal precision.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Standing before Orom to deliver the ruin tally and formulate the exact wording of the party's single wish.

primitives.name: Orom's Literal Wish-Stone Slab
primitives.description: Heavy heart-granite slab hammered with coarse runes. Answers spoken wishes literally: wish for a road, and a massive granite arch bridges the chasm ahead.

primitives.name: Grey Wind Hearth Brazier
primitives.description: Cold-forged brazier glowing with smoldering bistre embers where Orom tempers stone.
